alt_text.fig1: Six panels compare prescribed translated-plane motion with three front measurements at 10 and 5 micrometre grids; all methods show orientation-dependent voxel stair steps, while centroid and height median overlap.
alt_text.fig2: Signed stacked bars decompose the locked alpha-zero 20 micrometre advance error into evolving-area allocation, binary quantization, and measurement-definition contributions at 10 and 5 micrometre grids.
alt_text.fig3: Four panels compare analytical and reconstructed allocation controls, small and enlarged growth windows in a fixed interior, and residual local fill-fraction distributions.
alt_text.fig4: Accepted corrected interface area relative to the analytical disk is tracked across deposition stages for three orientations and two growth radii.
